cohort: 20 pregnant women booked for elective caesarean section (singleton pregnancy) and their newborn babies.
finding: Maternal temperature was maintained within normal levels in the intervention group (pre-warmed IV fluids), and reduced neonatal temperatures, leading to mild neonatal hypothermia, were identified, especially in the control group.
mod_finding: The study investigated the connection between maternal and infant hypothermia for babies delivered by caesarean section while undergoing skin-to-skin contact.
